value.content: {"id": "intel_tryhackme_fundamentals", "topic": "sqli", "title": "TryHackMe SQLi Fundamentals: In-Band, Inferential & Out-of-Band Mechanics", "source_url": "https://tryhackme.com/room/sqlinjectionlm", "prerequisites": ["sql_basics", "network_protocols"], "signals": ["in_band_union", "blind_boolean_differential", "time_delay_pg_sleep", "out_of_band_dns_lookup"], "verification_strategy": "Classify injection surface into three distinct tiers: (1) In-band (direct reflection/error in response), (2) Inferential / Blind (boolean content differential or statistical time delay), (3) Out-of-band / OAST (triggering external DNS/HTTP lookups via database built-ins like utl_http or xp_dirtree).", "evidence_requirements": ["injection_tier_classification", "reproducible_inferential_delta", "dns_interaction_id"], "remediation": "Apply defense-in-depth: Parameterized queries, restrictive database user permissions, and egress network filtering to block database servers from initiating outbound DNS/HTTP requests.", "description": "TryHackMe educational taxonomy divides SQL Injection into In-Band, Blind/Inferential, and Out-of-Band (OAST). Provides foundational methodology for selecting the appropriate experiment based on observable response characteristics."}
